build_value_network: build a fully connected value network using FullyConnected with custom sizes and activations
create_fully_connected_builder: create a FullyConnected value net builder with default layer sizes 256 and 128
configure_layer_norm: configure the FullyConnected builder to use layer normalization for value network training
validate_sizes_activations: validate that sizes and activations lists have matching lengths in FullyConnected initialization
get_state_dim: get the state dimension from normalization data to build a FloatFeatureFullyConnected network
